Verify in field | Verify in field is a construction document notation indicating that the dimensions on a drawing (including architectural, structural, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical plans or miscellaneous vendor shop drawings) require additional verification on the actual site or field.  This is commonly shown on drawings as "VIF".  Generally the dimensions to be verified will be highlighted by "bubbling" around them or through some other method to indicate that verification is required.
California Tax Education Council | The California Tax Education Council (CTEC) is a private nonprofit quasi-public benefit organization that is mandated by the State of California.  CTEC is responsible for providing a list of its approved tax education providers and verifying nonexempt tax preparers have met the state’s minimum requirements to prepare tax returns for a fee.
